prompts.text: Every weekday at 7am, post a morning brief to my Feed: today's calendar, anything urgent in my inbox and the weather.
Every Friday at 4pm, post a recap to my Feed of what we got done this week and what's still open.
Every evening at 6, post the emails that still need a reply from me. Remove the previous day's post when you add the new one.
Every Monday at 8am, post what [competitor] shipped or announced last week to my Feed, with links.
Every morning, check Reddit, Hacker News and the web for new mentions of [my brand] and post anything worth seeing.
Every Thursday, post three trends in [my industry] worth reacting to, and one line on why each matters.
Every Sunday evening, post five video ideas to my Feed based on what's trending in [my niche] this week.
Every weekday morning, post one thing in [my niche] worth writing about today, with an opening line I could use.
Once a week, post the comments and questions on my latest [videos / posts] that deserve an answer.
Every evening at 8, post what's coming up tomorrow: appointments, the weather and anything I need to bring.
Every Saturday at 9am, post three things to do in [my city] this weekend.
Twice a day, check my email for shipping updates and post to my Feed when a package changes status.
Every evening at 7, post the three most important AI news stories from the last 24 hours, in plain language.
Every Monday, post one new paper or long read about [topic], with a five-sentence summary.
Every weekday at 8:15am, post the pre-market moves for [my stock list], with one line on why each moved.
Every 12 hours, look at our recent chats and post Ideas for things you could take off my plate.
Look at my calendar for next week and post Ideas for meetings I could skip, shorten or prepare for.
Go through my inbox and post Ideas for newsletters I could unsubscribe from and filters you could set up.
Look at [my website] and post five Ideas to make the home page convert better.
Every Monday, post three marketing experiments for [my product] that I could finish in a day each.
Read the latest reviews of [my app / business] and post Ideas for fixes or replies that would win people over.
Take my latest [blog post / video] and post Ideas for turning it into short posts, a thread and a newsletter.
Post Ideas for a four-week content plan for [my channel], one per week, each with a working title.
Every Sunday, look at which of my posts did best this week and post Ideas for follow-ups.
Look through my email for subscriptions and recurring charges, and post Ideas for what I could cancel or downgrade.
Post Ideas for a date night in [my city] this month, with places that take reservations.
[Name]'s birthday is on [date]. Post three gift Ideas you could order for me, each under $[50].
Based on the tools and accounts you can reach, post Ideas for things you could automate for me.
I'm thinking about [buying a car / switching phone plans]. Post Ideas for the comparisons you could research for me.
Using what you know about me, post Ideas for side projects that fit my skills and free time.
Make a goal to keep my inbox under 20 unread. Check it each evening and update the status.
Track my [project] deadline on [date]. Keep the status on what's left and how many days remain.
Make a goal: no work after 6pm on weekdays. Keep it in mind when you suggest things.
Make a goal to reach [1,000] newsletter subscribers by [date]. Keep the current count in the status and suggest Ideas that help.
Track our launch on [date]. Keep the status on what's done and what's left, and tell me if anything slips.
Keep an eye on [my app's rating / my Google reviews] and update the status when it changes.
Make a goal to publish one [video / post] a week. Update the status when I ship, and suggest an Idea when I fall behind.
Make a goal to grow my [channel] to [5,000] subscribers by [month], and keep the latest count in the status.
Track my drafts: keep a count of what's in progress and what I should finish next.
Make a goal to lose [20] lbs by summer. Keep it in mind when you suggest meals, gyms or habits.
Track my order from [store]. Update the status when it changes, and mark it done when it arrives.
Make a goal to save $[5,000] for a trip to [place] by [month]. Update the status when I tell you what I've saved.
Make a goal to learn [Spanish / Swift] this year. Suggest one small thing to practice each week.
Track the price of [item] and update the status when it drops below $[amount].
Make a goal to read [20] books this year. Update the count when I tell you I've finished one.
